mainTopic: Love for ארץ ישראל and the days of the משיח: the closing lines of מסכת כתובות
overview: This is the last עמוד of מסכת כתובות. The גמרא finishes its list of חכמים who showed love for ארץ ישראל. Some kept moving between sun and shade so they would never complain about the land, and רבי חייא בר גמדא would roll in its dust, based on a פסוק in תהלים. The גמרא then describes the generation when בן דוד comes. There will be accusations against תלמידי חכמים, שמואל adds that there will be refining after refining, and רב יוסף teaches that there will be plunderers who are plundered in turn. The מסכת ends on a hopeful note: רב teaches that one day every barren tree in ארץ ישראל will bear fruit. The הדרן then closes the פרק and the whole מסכת.

steps.title: Moving between sun and shade so as never to complain
steps.stepSummary: The end of the story about חכמים who kept moving between sun and shade so they would always be comfortable in ארץ ישראל.
steps.simpleTranslation: They would get up and move from the sun to the shade, and from the shade to the sun.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes a story it began just before this point, about חכמים who showed love for ארץ ישראל. They kept changing seats so they would never feel uncomfortable there.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When the spot they sat in got too hot, they moved to the shade. When the shade got too cold, they moved back to the sun. That way they never had a reason to say anything bad about ארץ ישראל, not even about its weather.
steps.confusionAlert: This line starts in the middle of a story. The people doing the moving were named just before this point, so do not read it as a new topic.

phrases.english: would stand and move from the sun to the shade
phrases.notes: This continues a story that started just before here. The חכמים who did this were named there.

phrases.english: and from the shade to the sun.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes a list of examples of love for ארץ ישראל that was already in progress before this point.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: These חכמים adjusted themselves to the land's conditions rather than ever complaining about it.

steps.title: Rolling in the dust of the land
steps.stepSummary: רבי חייא בר גמדא would roll in the dust of ארץ ישראל, based on a פסוק in תהלים.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי חייא בר גמדא would roll in the dust of the land, as it says: "For Your servants take pleasure in her stones, and love her dust."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives one more example of love for ארץ ישראל. רבי חייא בר גמדא would actually roll in its dust.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק says that God's servants love even the stones and dust of ארץ ישראל. רבי חייא בר גמדא turned that פסוק into action and showed his love in the most physical way possible.

keyTerms.meaning: Its dust (the dust of the land)
As it is stated, introducing a פסוק
They cherish it, they love it

steps.whatToRemember: The חכמים showed their love for ארץ ישראל in physical ways: they never complained about it, and they even cherished its dust.

phrases.english: Rabbi Chiya bar Gamda
would roll in its dust,
as it is stated:
"For Your servants take pleasure in her stones,
and love her dust."

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר גַּמָּדָא מִיגַּנְדַּר בְּעַפְרַהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds the final example to the list of ways חכמים showed love for ארץ ישראל.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Loving even the dust of ארץ ישראל is the fulfillment of a פסוק.

steps.title: Accusations against Torah scholars before משיח comes
steps.stepSummary: רבי זירא, quoting רבי ירמיה בר אבא, says that the generation of בן דוד will have accusations against תלמידי חכמים.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי זירא said in the name of רבי ירמיה בר אבא: In the generation when בן דוד comes, there will be accusations against תלמידי חכמים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to a new topic: what the world will be like right before משיח comes. The first sign is that people will accuse and speak against תלמידי חכמים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Up to now the גמרא was talking about love for the land. Now it describes the hard times before the final redemption. The people who teach Torah will be under attack.

keyTerms.meaning: The son of David, meaning משיח

phrases.english: Rabbi Zeira said
that Rabbi Yirmeya bar Abba said:
The generation in which the son of David comes
there will be accusations against Torah scholars.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי זֵירָא אָמַר רַבִּי יִרְמְיָה בַּר אַבָּא דּוֹר שֶׁבֶּן דָּוִד בָּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Shifts from love of ארץ ישראל to describing the generation before משיח.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Before משיח comes, תלמידי חכמים will face accusations.

steps.title: שמואל adds: refinement after refinement
steps.stepSummary: When רבי ירמיה בר אבא told this to שמואל, שמואל said that generation will go through one round of refining after another, based on a פסוק in ישעיהו.
steps.simpleTranslation: When I said this in front of שמואל, he said: there will be refining after refining, as it says: "And if there is still a tenth left in it, it will again be burned up."
steps.whatsHappening: רבי ירמיה בר אבא tells us how שמואל responded to his teaching. שמואל adds that the generation of משיח will be tested and cleaned over and over again.
steps.deeperAnalysis: שמואל goes a step further than the accusations in the previous step. The hardship will come in more than one round. In the פסוק, even the tenth that survives the first round goes through another round, like metal heated again and again until it is pure.

keyTerms.meaning: Refining or purifying, like melting metal to remove what is impure
To be burned up or destroyed

phrases.english: When I said it before Shmuel
phrases.notes: "I" is רבי ירמיה בר אבא, the one quoted in the previous step.

phrases.english: he said: refinement after refinement,
as it is stated:
"And if there be yet a tenth in it,
it shall again be eaten up."

steps.triggerLanguage: כִּי אַמְרִיתַהּ קַמֵּיהּ דִּשְׁמוּאֵל אֲמַר צֵירוּף אַחַר צֵירוּף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: שמואל expands the description of the hardship before משיח: it will be repeated, not a single event.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The generation of משיח will go through repeated rounds of purification.

steps.title: Plunderers and plunderers of plunderers
steps.stepSummary: רב יוסף taught that in the time of משיח there will be plunderers, and then others who plunder those plunderers.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב יוסף taught: there will be plunderers, and plunderers of the plunderers.
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף adds another sign of the time before משיח. Robbers will take from the land, and then other robbers will take from them.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This matches שמואל's idea of hardship that comes in rounds. One wave of plunderers is followed by another wave that plunders them.
steps.whatToRemember: The time before משיח is described as hard: תלמידי חכמים are accused, there are repeated rounds of refining, and plunderers are themselves plundered.

phrases.english: Rav Yosef taught:
Plunderers, and plunderers of plunderers.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנֵי רַב יוֹסֵף בָּזוֹזֵי וּבָזוֹזֵי דְבָזוֹזִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds another sign of the troubled era before משיח, continuing the idea of repeated waves.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Before משיח comes, there will be waves of plunder, one after another.

steps.title: Every barren tree will bear fruit
steps.stepSummary: רב חייא בר אשי, quoting רב, says that in the future every barren tree in ארץ ישראל will bear fruit, based on a פסוק in יואל.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב חייא בר אשי said in the name of רב: In the future, every barren tree in ארץ ישראל will bear fruit, as it says: "For the tree carries its fruit, the fig tree and the vine give their strength."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא ends the מסכת on a hopeful note. One day even the trees in ארץ ישראל that never grew fruit will produce fruit.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק first says "a tree bears its fruit" and only afterward names the fig and the vine. רב reads "tree" as meaning any tree, including barren ones. After all the hard times described before, this shows the land's full blessing in the future.

keyTerms.meaning: Barren trees that do not produce fruit
That they will be loaded with fruit
Their strength, meaning their full produce

steps.whatToRemember: The מסכת ends with hope: in the future, ארץ ישראל will be so blessed that even barren trees will bear fruit.
steps.whyThisMatters: The חכמים chose to end כתובות with a blessing for ארץ ישראל, closing the long discussion of the land in this פרק on a positive note.

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַב חִיָּיא בַּר אָשֵׁי אָמַר רַב:
phrases.english: Rav Chiya bar Ashi said that Rav said:
In the future all barren trees
that are in Eretz Yisrael will bear fruit,
as it is stated:
"For the tree bears its fruit,
phrases.notes: "Tree" is mentioned separately from the fig and vine, so רב reads it as any tree at all.

phrases.english: the fig tree and the vine yield their strength."

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב חִיָּיא בַּר אָשֵׁי אָמַר רַב עֲתִידִין כׇּל אִילָנֵי סְרָק
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the hardships before משיח to the blessings that will follow.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: In the future, all barren trees in ארץ ישראל will bear fruit.

steps.title: הדרן: closing the פרק שני דייני גזירות and מסכת כתובות
steps.stepSummary: The closing formula for the last פרק, שני דייני גזירות, and for all of מסכת כתובות.
steps.simpleTranslation: We will return to you, פרק "שני דייני גזירות", and מסכת כתובות is complete.
steps.whatsHappening: This is not part of the discussion. It is the traditional line said when finishing a פרק, and here it also marks the end of the whole מסכת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: "הדרן עלך" expresses the hope that we will come back and learn this פרק again. The added words announce that מסכת כתובות is now finished.

keyTerms.meaning: We will return to you, said when finishing a פרק

steps.whatToRemember: מסכת כתובות ends here, closing with love for ארץ ישראל and hope for its future blessing.

phrases.english: We will return to you, "Two Judges of Decrees"
and Tractate Ketubot is completed.

steps.triggerLanguage: הֲדַרַן עֲלָךְ שְׁנֵי דַּיָּינֵי גְזֵירוֹת וּסְלִיקָא לַהּ מַסֶּכֶת כְּתוּבּוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Formally closes the פרק and the מסכת after the final teaching.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The פרק שני דייני גזירות and all of מסכת כתובות are complete.
